name: Hybrid Scattering
definition: A technique that switches stochastically between surface and volumetric scattering based on the local gradient to integrate both into stochastic volume rendering, providing specular highlights in areas of well-defined gradients and volumetric scattering in areas of ill-defined gradients.
summary: Hybrid Scattering is a stochastic technique that switches between surface BRDF and volumetric scattering based on local gradient magnitude to reduce sample variance and resolve rendering ambiguity.
